title: A conservative finite-volume Buckley--Leverett solver with bounded-interval multiwavelet state analysis
summary: We develop a conservative finite-volume Buckley--Leverett solver equipped with a bounded-interval multiwavelet state-analysis layer. Because non-capillary Buckley--Leverett transport is a nonlinear hyperbolic conservation law with entropy-admissible shocks, the saturation equation is advanced by a conservative finite-volume method with monotone numerical fluxes. The accepted finite-volume state is then embedded in a bounded-domain multiwavelet hierarchy, reconstructed back to cell averages, and used for multiresolution diagnostics.
